1.explanation:
• cascader-select.tsx: Contains the core logic for search filtering and multi-select state updates — where clearing the search value (or not) is implemented.  
• index.tsx: Exposes the component’s public API and default props, including search-related callbacks.  
• __docs__/index.md: Provides the overall component documentation and shows how search and multi-select are intended to work together.  
• __docs__/demo/search/index.tsx: Demonstrates basic search behavior within CascaderSelect, useful to compare desired vs. current behavior.  
• __docs__/demo/multiple/index.tsx: Shows multi-select usage without search — helps to isolate whether the issue is specific to search + multi-select.  
• __docs__/demo/search-async/index.tsx: Illustrates asynchronous search handling, which may highlight differences in how the search value is reset after selection.
1.bug_scenario: In the CascaderSelect dropdown the user types “厦门” into the search box, then selects all of the filtered items (each checkbox “福建 / 厦门”). After the last item is checked, the search keyword remains and the dropdown stays stuck on the filtered list. There is no in-component way to clear the search or return to the full list without closing and reopening the overlay.
